snippet.title: Survival: Caged - Full VN (evanatsu)
snippet.description:
Natsuhi calls Eva while she's at work. Eva sends to have her brought to her.

A 2,763 words evanatsu visual novel that takes place in Survival AU. Available now on itch.io. 
https://gfiascos.itch.io/survival-caged

If for whatever reason, the links don't work, it is also here in google drive. One for pc (Windows, Linux), & one for Mac. I have no way of testing the Mac version, but I assume it should work properly for you. Remember to extract the folder after download.
https://drive.google.com/drive/u/2/folders/1x7JOPrIE9oocddp_e7Kj9aYOmS8Jppqg

Here is a google doc that has the entire script so it's easier to copy & paste the text into translators while playing if English is not your first language, or if anyone wants it for another reason. There is also a notepad version of this in the folder.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1u7bucKwiYakPAlNv5FYzlMtR6tDVN6ywtHPKz92EuFg/edit?tab=t.0

This one is much more serious than my last VN, Catsuhi, so please mind the warnings. 
Thank you for reading, and I hope you enjoyed ❤️
